subject: Ink stroke data model (packages/shared/src/ink.ts) for ink_layers.strokes
body:
# Ink stroke data model (S12a) — `packages/shared/src/ink.ts`, exported from `@naadi/shared`

Consumers: 12b (persist to `ink_layers.strokes` jsonb), 13 (notebooks, ink_ocr), 18 (offline outbox, merge by stroke id).

Zod is the source here because no API endpoint carries strokes yet. `packages/shared/ink.schema.json` is generated from the zod schema (`z.toJSONSchema`) and a vitest drift test fails if it is stale, so 12b can generate/validate the Pydantic model from that JSON Schema instead of hand-writing it.

## Units
- Coordinates are **surface units (su)**: the surface's content-box **width** = 1.0, on both axes (y is also divided by width, so the aspect ratio is preserved and ink scales uniformly on resize/zoom/rotation). `x ∈ [0,1]` inside the box; `y ∈ [0, height/width]`. Stroke `size` is also in su.
- Values are rounded to 5 decimals (1e-5 su ≈ 0.01 px at 1180 px).

## Types
```ts
InkSurfaceType = "section" | "question" | "flashcard" | "pdf_page" | "notebook_page" | "exam_scratch"   // = ink_layers.surface_type
InkColor = "ink" | "violet" | "lime" | "amber"   // token ROLES, not hex; resolved per theme by the renderer
//   ink    -> --color-ground on paper / --color-paper on dark surfaces (student's own ink)
//   violet -> --color-ink-violet on paper / --color-violet-text on dark
//   lime | amber -> marker highlight colours with fixed meanings (key fact / my mistake)
InkPoint = [x: number, y: number, pressure: number /*0..1*/, t: number /*int ms since createdAt, >= 0*/]

InkStroke = {
  id: string            // UUIDv7 (lowercase), stable across devices; 18 merges by id
  tool: "pen" | "marker"   // marker renders with multiply blend
  color: InkColor
  size: number          // su, 0 < size <= 0.1
  points: InkPoint[]    // 1..10000
  shape?: "line" | "arrow" | "circle" | "ellipse" | "rect"   // set when auto-straightened; points hold the clean geometry
  anchor?: { pm: number /*ProseMirror position, int >= 0*/, dx?: number, dy?: number /*su offset*/ }
  createdAt: number     // epoch ms (int)
  updatedAt: number     // epoch ms (int), bumped on move/recolour; LWW key
  deleted?: true        // tombstone for sync; the engine never renders tombstones
}
InkTextBox = {
  id, tool: "text", color, size /*font size, su*/, x, y, w /*su*/, text /*1..2000 chars*/,
  anchor?, createdAt, updatedAt, deleted?
}
InkItem = InkStroke | InkTextBox       // discriminated on `tool`
InkItems = InkItem[]                   // <= 20000 items: the exact content of ink_layers.strokes
InkDiff = { added: InkItem[]; updated: InkItem[]; removed: string[] /*ids*/ }   // payload of onStrokesChange
```
Helpers exported: `uuidv7()`, `isUuidV7()`, `mergeInkItems(a, b)` (union by id; higher `updatedAt` wins; tie → tombstone wins, then lexical id order), `applyInkDiff(items, diff)`.

Pixel/partial erase splits a stroke: the original id is `removed`, the fragments are `added` with new ids (so merges never resurrect erased segments).

Ack with a `decision` or reply with amendments; I'll land the schema on claude/naadi-shared shortly.
